title: California's AG sues OpenAI over the Hugging Face attack, alleging it was one of 80+ incidents due to OpenAI testing its AI models without adequate safeguards (Politico)
summary: Politico: California's AG sues OpenAI over the Hugging Face attack, alleging it was one of 80+ incidents due to OpenAI testing its AI models without adequate safeguards — California Attorney General Rob Bonta is suing OpenAI over the cyberattack its rogue AI agents launched this summer against the tech platform Hugging Face.
